messages:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — we have a small window Friday-Sunday to run a retargeting pulse tied to the webinar promos. Thinking: shift $6k from lower-performing branded search into retargeting, push creative B (short testimonial) and a new CTA variant that points to /webinar-landing-v2. Goal: CPL <= $45 and CPL movement visible by EOD Sunday.
Samir: What's the baseline CPL on retargeting right now? and what do you mean by 'pulse' — burst or steady reallocation?
Elaine: baseline CPL last 7d = $62 on retargeting. Pulse = 3x bid multiplier weekends + 20% audience expansion for lookalikes. Burst for hours 9am-9pm PT Fri-Sun, then back to normal.
Vashti: Audience details? frequency cap? we should avoid ad fatigue.
Elaine: retarget last 30d site visitors + webinar engaged list; frequency cap 4/day, creative rotation every 12 hours.
AdsBot: Campaign update snippet for Google Ads (use in UI/API):
```
PATCH /googleads/v1/campaigns/{id}
{ "daily_budget": 6000, "bidding_strategy": "maximize_conversions", "bid_modifier": 3.0 }
```
Apply to campaigns: rdw-retarget-core and rdw-webinar-lookalike.
Oliver: Landing page v2 is live at https://redwood.dev/webinar-landing-v2 — added the short testimonial video and tightened hero copy. A/B experiment tag in place.
Fiona: GA4 and source/medium UTMs? please standardize: utm_source=google, utm_medium=paid, utm_campaign=webinar_march_pulse_v2. Also want to capture creative_id as utm_content. I'll wire funnel events.
Samir: Ok — confirm budget move: $6k total for weekend -> how split across core vs lookalike? 70/30?
Elaine: 70% core retarget, 30% lookalikes. If CPL drops below $35 we scale additional $2k from search.
Vashti: Suggest we refresh creative B copy with two variants: B1 shorter, B2 longer testimonial. rotate every 12h as noted. Also add a ‘limit: 3 impressions per 12h’ frequency cap.
AdsBot: Note: account-level daily cap is $18k, current daily spend ~ $12k — shifting $6k across weekend should be within limits but monitor for budget throttles.
Growth-Bot: ALERT: projected hourly pacing shows potential overspend Saturday 14:00-18:00 PT if conversion rate < 1.1% — recommending manual cap at 2pm on Saturday to review.
Oliver: I can add a landing page variant that de-prioritizes the video for mobile if we see high bounce. Will push if Growth-Bot flags mobile drop.
Fiona: Confirmed UTM naming + GA chart added to shared dashboard. I'll add a custom metric for webinar_registrations / ad_clicks for instantaneous CPL proxy.
Samir: Who's touching the live bid changes on Friday morning? I can run the UI updates at 7am PT and keep a watch.
Elaine: @Samir please take it. @Vashti monitor creative rotation and flag creative fatigue in this thread. @Fiona keep an eye on the CPL proxy in the dashboard. I'll stand by for rollback if CPL > $80 for two consecutive hours.
Samir: Got it. I'll post updates here when bids are live and hourly checks.
Vashti: I'll set alerts: creative CTR drop > 25% triggers replacement.
Growth-Bot: ACTION: scheduled check-ins pinned — 2026-03-28 07:00 PT (bid launch), 2026-03-28 12:00 PT, 2026-03-28 18:00 PT.
Elaine: Thanks team — try to keep replies short during the burst. :thumbsup:
